info.title: hausfold.co
info.summary: Public endpoints for hausfold's Mac software: installers, release metadata, docs search, and an MCP endpoint for coding agents.
info.description: Everything here is public. No API keys, no accounts, nothing to buy. hausfold makes Mac software: haus, a layer that rebuilds a whole Mac from one text file, and small apps that run on it (and without it). See https://hausfold.co/developers/ for prose examples and the MCP tool list.

get.summary: Install script for the haus layer; asks which desktop to build
get.description: Proxies haus's bootstrap.sh with nothing pinned, so the installer interviews you. Run it with `curl -fsSL https://hausfold.co/haus.sh | bash`.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Pin the bootstrap.sh source to an exact haus release tag (vYYYY.MM.DD or vYYYY.MM.DD-N). Unpublished: main is the default.

200.description: The installer as plain text, pinned via HAUS_DESKTOP. `x-hausfold-ref` names the ref it was fetched from.

x-hausfold-ref.description: The ref the script was proxied from (a release tag, or main before the first release).

400.description: A ref that is not a release tag was requested.

502.description: The upstream script could not be fetched.

get.summary: Redirect to the latest macOS release artifact of an app
get.description: 302 to the most-preferred macOS asset of the app's latest GitHub release (DMG preferred over the archive). GitHub keeps hosting the bytes and counting downloads.

302.description: Redirect to the asset's download URL, or to the repo's releases page when no signed artifact is found.

get.summary: Latest release metadata for an app
get.description: Small JSON document (tag, asset, size, url, publishedAt) for labelling a download button with the real version instead of one hardcoded to go stale. Cached at the edge for five minutes.

502.description: GitHub's release API could not be reached.

get.description: Proxied from the workshop repo's docs/design.md. Intended for a coding agent to load before drawing something that carries the brand.

502.description: The upstream file could not be fetched.

get.summary: The full-text search index of the documentation
get.description: The complete search index (Orama JSON format) behind /docs: one entry per page section with url, breadcrumbs and content. search_docs on /mcp scores this same index.

get.summary: Documentation as markdown for LLMs, index form
get.description: One entry per docs page. Plain text, no runtime.

get.summary: Documentation as markdown for LLMs, full text
get.description: Every docs page's full text in one file. Plain text, no runtime.

post.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 over Streamable HTTP. Stateless: no session ids, and GET is refused (405) because there is nothing to stream. Open CORS, no authentication. Initialize, then list or call tools; every tool reads public data.

parameters.name: mcp-protocol-version
parameters.description: Optional. Informational for this server: negotiation happens in the initialize request's protocolVersion parameter; the response's mcp-protocol-version header names the version the server answered with.

200.description: JSON-RPC response (single object, or array for a batch).

202.description: The request (or every message in the batch) was a notification; there is nothing to reply.

405.description: Method not POST. GET would open an SSE stream; this server has nothing to push.

options.description: Open preflight: any origin, POST, and the MCP headers.

installer.description: The installer as plain text, pinned via HAUS_DESKTOP. `x-hausfold-ref` names the ref it was fetched from and `x-hausfold-desktop` echoes the pin.

x-hausfold-ref.description: The ref the script was proxied from (a release tag, or main before the first release).

x-hausfold-desktop.description: The desktop this URL pinned. Absent on /haus.sh, which pins nothing.
